# RunPod templates

MiniMax H3 FL2VA and Ref2VA each have two RunPod templates:

- **Standard:** Manual provision prompt enhancer used by this workflow
- **Plus QWEN prompt enhancer:** provisions the local Qwen3.8 GGUF prompt enhancer used by this workflow.

## FL2VA

- [Deploy MiniMax H3 FL2VA](https://console.runpod.io/deploy?template=v7b5g03csk&ref=se4tkc5o)
- [Deploy MiniMax H3 FL2VA plus prompt enhancer](https://console.runpod.io/hub/template/a1nkufhzxq?ref=se4tkc5o)

## Ref2VA

- [Deploy MiniMax H3 Ref2VA](https://console.runpod.io/deploy?template=6qtfx7lxgc&ref=se4tkc5o)
- [Deploy MiniMax H3 Ref2VA plus prompt enhancer](https://console.runpod.io/hub/template/pcsqepl6kt?ref=se4tkc5o)

# Manual Qwen3.8 prompt-enhancer download

The **plus prompt enhancer** template provisions these files automatically. For manual installation:

```bash
mkdir -p /workspace/ComfyUI/models/LLM/Qwen3.8

hf download theresa00l/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8-Q4_K_M-GGUF \
  qwen3.8-27b-uncensored-fp8-q4_k_m.gguf \
  --local-dir /workspace/ComfyUI/models/LLM/Qwen3.8

hf download unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF \
  mmproj-F16.gguf \
  --local-dir /workspace/ComfyUI/models/LLM/Qwen3.8
```

Refresh (press r) after downloading.

# Image / first-last-frame video - LightX2V

## Purpose
Animate an input image, with an optional last frame to guide the ending. Qwen-VL provides integrated prompt enhancement.

## Use
1. Load the relevant input media and enter your scene instructions.
2. Use the Qwen-VL prompt node and review its generated prompt.
3. Set video output size and duration, then run the generation workflow.

Workflow: lightx2v-fl2v-prompt-generator-qwenvl-pod.json
